description: Canonical frozen preregistered constants and thresholds for APEDP-X / CPMD discovery and adjudication.

notes.tactical_active_fraction_max: Harmonized and pinned to 0.90 after resolving historical documentation drift from 0.95 in audit.
notes.stage2_min_ic: Promotion stage 2 (PREDICTIVE_RECOVERY) minimum in-sample information coefficient enforced by promotion_lifecycle.check_stage2.
notes.stage4_min_oos_ic: Promotion stage 4 (OUT_OF_SAMPLE_TRANSFER) minimum out-of-sample information coefficient.
notes.stage5_min_fee_bps: Promotion stage 5 (ECONOMIC_VALIDITY) minimum gross edge in basis points required to survive trading fees.
notes.stage6_prospective_sharpe_hurdle: Promotion stage 6 (REAL_MARKET_PROMOTION) prospective Sharpe hurdle for live promotion.
notes.stage6_max_drawdown_ceiling: Promotion stage 6 maximum tolerated drawdown for live promotion.

literature_baselines: Kyle (1985) Continuous Auctions and Informed Trader
Biais, Hillion, Spatt (1995) / Large (2007) Order Book Resiliency
